integrity: The proof is analytic and uses the source formulas for the orbit, Gaussian inner products, and harmonic mesh. The Riemann-sum limit and Gaussian integral are derived explicitly. A finite numerical check is supplementary only and is not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the harmonic-mesh orbit in the cited firmly nonexpansive construction and does not classify other meshes or general firmly nonexpansive mappings.
The vectors y_n remain only weakly convergent to zero; the result identifies the limit of their norms, not a strong vector limit.
The originality assessment is bounded by the inspected literature and databases; an equivalent calculation under different terminology remains a residual risk.
